sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Frequent, difficult, and painful urination.
IPop.] Gravelly deposits. Catarrhal and purulent dis-
charges. [Pareira.] Strangury, pyelitis; enlarged
prostate. Chronic cystic irritability. Incontinence; con-
stant desire. Urine is dense and causes irritation of
the mucous surfaces.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Tradescantia (painful
urination, urethral discharge; scrotum inflamed).
Chimaph,; Senecio; Populus trem.
